title: Rain Gear Return Policy
text: RainShell Pro Jacket and other waterproof rain gear may be returned within a 60-day window. Returned waterproof items must be clean, dry, and free of trail mud. Warranty inspection is separate from normal returns.

title: RainShell Pro Jacket Product Guide
text: RainShell Pro Jacket is a waterproof, breathable, packable hiking jacket priced at $129.99. It is designed for hiking, rain, and travel. Customers often compare it with fleece layers, but fleece is warm rather than waterproof.

title: SparkMini Camp Stove Fuel Guide
text: SparkMini Camp Stove uses threaded isobutane canisters. Use the stove outdoors only, keep it away from tents, and let it cool before packing. The stove is compact, fuel-efficient, and intended for backpacking meals.

title: Shipping to Canada
text: OutdoorGear ships to Canada using tracked international shipping. Most Canadian orders arrive in 5-8 business days after fulfillment. Duties and taxes may be collected by the carrier at delivery.

title: SummitLite Tent Warranty
text: SummitLite tents include a two-year warranty for manufacturing defects. Broken poles caused by normal use are covered, but damage from storms, fires, or improper storage is excluded.

title: Sleeping Bag Temperature Ratings
text: CloudRest sleeping bags use comfort and lower-limit ratings. A 20F sleeping bag is suitable for cold spring and fall nights when paired with an insulated sleeping pad and dry base layers.
